correctness.rationale: Matrix-tree theorem for a fixed root set of size c yields c n^{n-c-1} rooted forests and the truncated-Poisson cycle distribution. Deleting j specified pendant vertices gives c(n-j)^{n-c-1} surviving attachments, which agrees for all j with avoidance of j specified boxes after n-c-1 uniform throws. For c=n, pure cycle L=0. Conditional mean m(1-1/n)^{m-1} strictly increases with m=n-c (for supported m), producing negative covariance via the independent-copy identity. Conditional occupancy martingale decomposition yields vacancy CLT variance (e-2)/e^2, uniformly for c=O(sqrt n); n-C is Poisson(n) conditioned below n-3, hence C/sqrt n -> |N|. The quadratic mean response (1-x^2)/(2e), bounded uniformly integrably, gives -1/(e sqrt(2pi)) covariance limit. Direct independent complete n-edge graph census n=3..6 checked exact conditional factorial moments. General assertions proved analytically, finite enumeration corroborative.
